ticker_news.title: Mobile Augmented Reality Market Size to Surpass USD 327.7 Billion by 2032, Rising at a CAGR of 30.84% | Report by SNS Insider
ticker_news.description: The Mobile Augmented Reality market is projected to grow from USD 29.2 Billion in 2024 to USD 327.7 Billion by 2032, with a CAGR of 30.84%. Growth is driven by increasing AR adoption in smartphones, gaming, retail, and enterprise applications.
ticker_news.author: Sns Insider
